# Privasys X.509 OID scheme v2

<!-- Code generated by oidgen from oids.json; DO NOT EDIT. -->

Arc `1.3.6.1.4.1.65230`. One slot, one meaning, on both editions; numbers are contiguous within an arc; a retired slot is never reused; evidence is never a certificate extension; the app-defined sub-arc root (5.4) never carries a value. The v1 column is documentation for reading old certificates and old records; the SDKs parse v2 only.
